bug_semantics: A client able to reach an Apache Kyuubi frontend protocol could supply a local Spark resource path such as /allowed/root/../../etc/passwd. The server authorized the unnormalized URI path with a textual uri.getPath.startsWith comparison against kyuubi.session.local.dir.allow.list; downstream path resolution then collapsed '..' and accessed a server-local file outside the allowed directory.
flaw_origin: PR #2991 source member 4f2faa6a22541ef850f5b049149e08ab6fd4c49b first created the reachable allow-list gate and its vulnerable localDirAllowList.exists(uri.getPath.startsWith(_)) predicate. The later member 6eca2f8beaa46242cac1d0b67632b1a90c4d08f0 moved the already-vulnerable predicate, and b585fb4257995d5dd8905c0a25e62a13a1264b77 is the aggregate squash that landed the ten-member PR, so neither is the smallest real BIC.
